title: attavo plan
description: The Plan's order, kept in the product's datastore and never committed: epics in rank order, each with its issues in rank order; edges between issues; policy. The optional claims map holds the draft claims of an issue that has no spec yet. It holds no issue text or state. attavo/plan.py checks the same shape with the standard library, plus what a schema cannot say: an issue is in at most one epic, an edge never joins an issue to itself, a claims key is an issue number, and a claimed path has no .. segment.

epics.description: In rank order. An epic with id backlog must exist.

issues.description: In rank order within the epic.

claims.description: Draft claims, keyed by issue number: the repository paths an issue will change before it has a spec. Once its branch exists the branch's own claims govern and these are not read.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths or globs; a trailing /** is allowed.
